<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a crafting material, obtained by clicking on a [[bucket of clear water]] in your inventory and selecting <i><b>Use</b></i>. It is used in a variety of crafting recipes, in addition to [[alchemy]] where-in it can be used in place of a powder, solution, or extract, with the [[alchemy workbench (tier I)]] and [[alchemy workbench (tier II)]].
